title: The School Bus That Comes At Midnight (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, the midnight school bus drove your whole class into the forest. And the driver had no eyes.
The bus stops at a little wooden school in the trees.
Every window is lit. A bell rings.
The kids get off in a straight line. You follow. What else can you do?
Inside, there's one teacher. Tall. Thin. Holding a register.
"Good," she says. "Everyone is on time. For once."
She reads the names. Every kid answers, "Present."
You don't answer. Your mouth is too dry.
The whole class turns and looks at you.
"Late again?" the teacher whispers. "You know the rule."
You run. Out of the door. Through the trees. You don't stop until you see the town.
In the morning, you're first at the real bus stop. On time for the first time ever.
The bus arrives. Your class waves from the windows. Normal. Noisy. Happy.
*But your best friend leans out and says, "You missed the bus last night. She's still waiting."
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
